strategies.name: Baseline Unrolled 8-Stage AllReduce
strategies.desc: Direct translation of the reference: 8 sequential all_reduce calls with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling/decoupling operations (apply forward coupling, reduce, undo coupling for next stage). 8 collective dispatches, ~224KB payload each. Simplest structure but maximum dispatch overhead.

strategies.name: Fused Coupling with Reduce-Scatter/AllGather
strategies.desc: Replace each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (scatter shards to owners) + allgather pattern. Each rank computes its owned shard's coupling locally after reduce_scatter, then allgather reconstructs the full vector. 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but smaller per-rank payloads (~1KB RS, ~224KB AG), potentially better network utilization.

strategies.name: Pipelined AllReduce with Async Dispatch
strategies.desc: Issue all 8 all_reduce operations back-to-back using async dispatch with explicit mark_step boundaries, allowing local coupling/decoupling ops to overlap with collective network transfers. Still 8 dispatches but computation-communication overlap reduces wall-clock time at the cost of increased intermediate buffer memory.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction Tree
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology (if num_nodes > 1): first perform intra-node all_reduce (smaller world size), apply coupling logic, then inter-node all_reduce across node representatives, broadcast back. Reduces cross-node traffic but requires 16+ dispatches (8 stages × 2 levels) and complex shard redistribution logic.

strategies.name: Batched All-to-All with Coupled Payloads
strategies.desc:
Reformulate as all_to_all where each rank sends its locally-coupled shard variants to all others, accumulates received data, then applies decoupling. Single all_to_all per stage (8 total dispatches) with W×S payload per rank (~224KB send/recv buffers). Trades compute (redundant coupling per sender) for simpler communication pattern.
